title: Nairobi Urban Development Manifesto
description: Comprehensive plan for Nairobi's transformation into a world-class metropolitan city
content: Nairobi deserves better. This manifesto outlines our vision for a city that works for everyone - from improved transport to affordable housing, better healthcare to quality education. We will transform Nairobi into a city of opportunities.

title: Youth Empowerment Plan
description: Detailed strategy for creating jobs and opportunities for Nairobi's youth
content: Our youth are the future of Nairobi. We will create 500,000 jobs through skills training, entrepreneurship support, and industrial development. Every young person in Nairobi will have access to opportunities.

title: Nairobi Economic Recovery Plan
description: Business-focused approach to restore Nairobi's economic glory
content: As a seasoned administrator and businessman, I understand what Nairobi needs. My plan focuses on fiscal responsibility, business-friendly policies, and strategic investments to jumpstart our economy.

title: Bottom-Up Economic Agenda
description: Transformative economic plan focusing on grassroots development
content: The Bottom-Up Agenda is about empowering ordinary Kenyans. We will invest in small businesses, agriculture, and manufacturing to create jobs and shared prosperity from the ground up.

title: Azimio la Umoja Manifesto
description: Progressive vision for Kenya's social and economic transformation
content: Azimio la Umoja represents our collective hope for a better Kenya. We will strengthen healthcare, education, and social protection while building a united, prosperous nation for all.

title: Westlands Development Charter
content: Westlands deserves focused development. My charter addresses roads, water, security, and market development. We will ensure every corner of Westlands benefits from devolved funds and national development.

title: Women Empowerment Manifesto
description: Comprehensive plan for women's rights and economic empowerment
content: Women are the backbone of our society. This manifesto outlines concrete steps to ensure women's participation in leadership, economic empowerment, and protection from gender-based violence.

title: Parliamentary Reform Agenda
description: Plan to strengthen parliamentary oversight and democratic processes
content: Parliament must be the true voice of the people. My agenda focuses on strengthening oversight, improving legislative processes, and ensuring public participation in governance.
